description.value:
On a Single Shot you can Burst Fire: 2 extra rounds, and every round counts as Armor-Piercing (short on rounds, it's a normal shot that empties the magazine). Works with shells. On guns that already fire bursts, the 2 rounds add on. Fixed (100eb): Burst Fire only. Bimodal (250eb): Single Shot or Burst Fire, no Autofire or Suppressive Fire. Selective (500eb): every mode plus Burst Fire. Optional nerf: Burst Fire attacks use the Autofire DVs.

Cost: Varies
Fits: All Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns, and Assault Rifles capable of Autofire, or which already expend more than 1 round of ammunition when fired in Single Shot

Item Compendium (2070) • Attachments & Mods
